question: Why can guest not export Teachers (403) in UntisX (endpoint /subjects)?
answer: Check role guest. Module Teachers may require higher permissions. Error 403: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /subjects and the database connection. Feature Filter must be enabled.
